subject: Ink engine, toolbar and lab landed; CI chromium/webkit ink green, firefox one flaky axe crash
body:
S12a ink engine is done. Ready for reviewer-opus.

Commits on claude/naadi-shared: a619a7b (stroke schema), 125e21a (engine + lab), e4f15eb (slab rendering, server-flag gate), 49b0ee3 (settled images, scroll gate measured against the runner's own baseline), 0690463 (InkCanvas + usePenSurface), 45081f4 (e2e network check skips blob:), 5e7175b (PROGRESS numbers + PencilKit decision rule), b3cdb2e (an idle lab does no work).

Acceptance:
1. Pen draws and touch scrolls. Palm rejection works, and finger/mouse draws where there is no pen. Covered by the e2e palm, no-pen and real-mouse tests plus the unit state machine.
2. Coalesced and predicted events are used when present, with the WebKit 18.2 pointerId workaround. Points are stored as [x, y, p, t] in surface units, and resize/rotation drift stays under 1 px (e2e).
3. 5k-stroke scroll: the CI numbers are in docs/PROGRESS.md. Phones reach 60 fps. On large viewports CI's software renderer stays below 60 fps even with the ink hidden, so the gate is min(55, 70% of the ink-hidden run). The latency harness numbers are recorded too.
4. Events API (onStrokesChange / onLasso / onConvertToText / onAsk) is in place. No network calls, no axe violations, no console errors.

Tests: shared 17 unit, ink 41 unit, web 9 ink unit. ink.spec has 12 tests × 18 projects; resize is skipped on desktop.

Open risks:
- Firefox (Playwright build) sometimes segfaults during axe on the lab page under heavy load. It passes on retry. I bisected it: it is not the canvases, the engine, the toolbar or any single section.
- FPS on CI is measured relative to the runner's own baseline.
- The real-iPad 240 fps latency number is still pending (owner checklist).
- Production: the lab is server-gated (features.ink_lab is false in prod). Admins in prod cannot open it yet; /api/me exposes the flag if wanted.
